_about: What the book guides quote, and where from. Each witness names a CCEL volume, the id of the chapter in CCEL's ThML file, and the first and last words of the passage. scripts/build_bookguides.py takes the words between them from that file, so nothing here is typed out. 'topic' is author (who wrote it and why), reception (how the church received it) or background (people the book's setting is often tied to). 'via' is the writer who quotes an earlier one.
